title: KRDPASS Auth SDK Redirect URI Validation Test Vectors
description: Canonical test cases for redirect URI validation across all SDK platforms

rule.summary: HTTPS scheme required, host required and must match configured host, any HTTPS path allowed
details: Configured redirect URI must use 'https' scheme and have a non-empty host
Incoming redirect URI must use 'https' scheme and have a non-empty host
Incoming redirect URI host must match configured redirect URI host exactly
Path is NOT validated: any HTTPS path on the same host is allowed
Query parameters are allowed and not validated

vectors.description: Exact match of configured redirect URI
vectors.reason: Scheme, host, and path all match configured URI
Host matches configured host; path difference is allowed
Host matches configured host; any path including root is allowed

vectors.description: Same host with query parameters (should pass)
vectors.reason: Host matches; query parameters are allowed

vectors.description: Same host, different path, with query parameters (should pass)
vectors.reason: Host matches; path difference and query parameters are both allowed

vectors.description: HTTP scheme instead of HTTPS (should fail)
vectors.reason: HTTP scheme is not allowed; only HTTPS is permitted
Host is required and cannot be empty
Host must match configured redirect URI host exactly
Host must match exactly; subdomain differences are not allowed

vectors.description: Same host with different port (should fail)
vectors.reason: Host comparison should include port if present; port mismatch is a host mismatch
Invalid URI format should fail validation
Empty string is not a valid URI

vectors.note: Most URL parsers normalize scheme to lowercase; should pass if parser handles it
vectors.reason: Scheme comparison should be case-insensitive (HTTPS = https)

vectors.description: IPv4 address as host (should pass if configured)
vectors.reason: IPv4 addresses are valid hosts; should match if configured host is IPv4

vectors.description: IPv6 address as host (should pass if configured)
vectors.reason: IPv6 addresses are valid hosts; should match if configured host is IPv6
